salotto.desc: A welcoming living room where contemporary design meets Roman warmth. Soft sofas, natural light, and a view of the private garden create the perfect atmosphere to relax after a day among the monuments.

camera1.desc: The master bedroom with king-size bed, Egyptian cotton linen, and warm terracotta walls. The perfect retreat for unforgettable Roman nights, with soft lighting and absolute comfort.

camera2.title: Bedroom 2
camera2.desc: The second bedroom with twin beds, desk, and bookshelf. Ideal for children, friends, or work colleagues, with the same attention to detail and comfort as the master bedroom.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your stay

q1.question: How does check-in work?
q1.answer: We offer 24/7 self check-in with digital code. You'll receive detailed instructions via WhatsApp the day before arrival. For arrivals after 10 PM, autonomous check-in is always available.

q2.question: How far is the Metro station?
q2.answer: Basilica San Paolo Metro B station is just a 3-minute walk away. From there you can reach the Colosseum in 15 minutes, Termini in 20 minutes, and EUR in 10 minutes.

q3.question: Is parking available?
q3.answer: Yes, there are paid parking lots nearby. Free parking available on side streets. We can also arrange private parking with advance notice.

q4.question: How do I get from the airport?
q4.answer: From Fiumicino Airport, take the regional train to Roma Ostiense (35 min), then 2 Metro B stops to Basilica San Paolo. Alternatively, taxi for approximately €45.

q5.question: Is it suitable for families with children?
q5.answer: Absolutely! The private garden is perfect for children, we have a highchair and travel cot available on request. The house is spacious and safe for little ones.

q6.question: Can I work from here?
q6.answer: Of course! Fast fiber Wi-Fi, desk in the second bedroom, quiet environment. Ideal for remote work, visiting professors, or business trips to EUR.

q7.question: What is the cancellation policy?
q7.answer: Free cancellation up to 5 days before arrival. For long stays, customized conditions. Contact us directly for more details.
